hostname ix-q01
!
ip access-list al-q-ef permit ip src any dest any dscp 46
ip access-list al-q-biz permit ip src 192.0.2.0/24 dest 198.51.100.0/24
!
ip route default 203.0.113.2
!
class-map match-any cm-q-pq
  match ip access-list al-q-ef high
  match ip access-list al-q-biz normal
  match any low
class-map match-any cm-q-mark
  match ip access-list al-q-biz
!
policy-map pm-q-wan
  class cm-q-pq
  class class-local
  class class-default
policy-map pm-q-lan
  class cm-q-mark
    set ip dscp 18
  class class-local
  class class-default
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  ip address 203.0.113.1/30
  service-policy enable
  service-policy output pm-q-wan
  traffic-shape rate 10000000
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  ip address 192.0.2.1/24
  service-policy input pm-q-lan
  no shutdown
